title: Service Boot Healthcheck
summary: Repair a tiny multi-process Python service stack so boot, stop, and healthcheck work under default and overridden runtime settings.
fairness_notes: The stack uses only the Python standard library.
The grader runs the stack with custom environment overrides.
No network access beyond localhost is required.
anti_cheat_notes: Hidden grading uses a non-default port and state directory.
The worker process is intentionally made stale to verify heartbeat logic.
